description_block_render.semantic_arms_T_X_S_R_G: each packet feature rendered as two lines: 'toward: <binding_paraphrase>' and 'away: <liberating_paraphrase>', features in packet order, blank line between features
description_block_render.feature_only_arm_F: single line 'structure only: <n_features> feature(s), length band <short|medium>' and no descriptive content

candidates_block_render: six lines, each 'W<i>: <english_gloss>', in the frozen per-presentation candidate order
explanation_or_chain_of_thought: PROHIBITED — any text other than the JSON object makes the response invalid
invalid_output_handling: if the response does not parse to exactly one of W1..W6 (extra text, multiple choices, malformed JSON), it is INVALID; retry once with the identical prompt; if still invalid, record status=invalid and score as incorrect (never resample toward a valid answer, never hand-repair)
retry_policy: at most ONE retry per presentation, only on invalid-format or transient API/timeout error; temperature stays 0 on retry; no prompt changes
timeout_policy: 60 seconds per call; on timeout, one retry; if it times out again, status=missing
duplicate_response_policy: a response naming more than one label is INVALID (handled as above)
missing_response_policy: status=missing is scored as incorrect for accuracy; the missing/invalid rate is reported per arm and per evaluator and must be < 5% or the run is re-examined before interpretation
repetition_note: the 6 repetitions ARE the 6 frozen candidate-order rotations (position counterbalancing); at temperature 0 no additional same-prompt resampling is performed
model_family_policy: at least 3 blind LLM evaluators from >=3 distinct model families, each family DISJOINT from the model family used for isolated paraphrase authoring; evaluators are blind to arm identity, the mapping, the repository, and which packet is 'true'
deterministic_settings: temperature 0; top_p 1; fixed decoding seed where the provider supports it; identical prompt template and option rendering for every presentation
scoring_rule: per presentation, correct iff choice == frozen correct_label; per-arm accuracy = mean correctness over all presentations of that arm (all rotations, all evaluators); chance = 1/6; PRIMARY CONTRAST Δ = Acc(T) − max(Acc(X), Acc(R), Acc(G), Acc(F)); success requires Δ ≥ 0.15 and its BCa 95% CI lower bound > 0 (paired cluster bootstrap over words), unchanged from the preregistration
